pages.text: “On a cold winter night, by the fireplace, a cup of hot cocoa brings not only warmth but also comfort.”$(br2)Hot Cocoa is a rich and sweet drink made by carefully simmering ground cocoa powder, sugar, and milk. It provides instant healing while also granting Cold Resistance, ensuring warmth from the inside out.

$(br2)$(br)To prepare Hot Cocoa, $(br)boil two portions of ground cocoa powder with sugar and milk.$(br)It is perfect for cold environments, helping travelers withstand harsh winter conditions while quickly restoring health.

Upon drinking Hot Cocoa, travelers receive an Instant Health effect and gain Cold Resistance, preventing them from being affected by freezing temperatures.$(br)This warm and comforting drink is ideal for snowy adventures.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
